top_signals.title: Commission takes a key step forward on 2027 financial support for Ukraine
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 30 Oct 2026 Today, the European Commission took another step in the implementation of the €90 billion Ukraine Support Loan,  which will provide Ukraine with essential budgetary support and defence products in 2026 and 2027. The package adopted today includes a proposal for the Council to approve the remaining loan amount of €45 billion for 2027.
